summary: Modularize and harden SaaS lifecycle conformance

delivery.outcome: Decompose standard/conformance.py (723L) into six focused modules strictly < 500 lines, eliminate bool-as-int acceptance and unhashable list crashes, enforce JSON Schema field/length/enum parity, reject duplicate JSON keys, symlinks, and inline bearer/private-key secrets, narrow adversarial catching strictly to ContractError, and sync dsl-manifest.json.
nonGoals: Do not modify pinned vendored standard/lifecycle.py or normative JSON schemas

architecture.decision: Split standard/conformance.py into saas_contracts.py, saas_validators.py, saas_usage.py, saas_examples.py, saas_profiles.py, and conformance.py (< 500 lines each) while re-exporting all public entrypoints from conformance.py and updating artifact digests in dsl-manifest.json.
architecture.rollback: Revert modularized standard/*.py conformance files and restore dsl-manifest.json.

validation.evidence: All positive, ledger, and 70 adversarial conformance checks, governance gates, and wellman checks pass.
